findings.principle: Nielsen #5 & #9 — Error prevention; help users recover
findings.title: Click on “Developer Guide” triggered a JavaScript error
findings.detail: 1 interaction(s) with this element threw a runtime error. The action likely failed silently.
findings.fix: Fix the underlying error and add a user-facing error state with a way to retry.

findings.title: 4 text element(s) fail colour contrast on /ai-gateway
findings.detail: Lowest ratio 4.46:1 (needs 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text). 33% of checked text fails.
findings.fix: Darken text or lighten backgrounds to meet WCAG 1.4.3 contrast minimums.

findings.title: No visible focus indicator on 19/19 sampled controls (/ai-gateway)
findings.detail: Keyboard users cannot see where they are on the page.
findings.fix: Never remove outlines without replacement — use :focus-visible with a high-contrast ring.

findings.principle: Hick's Law · Nielsen #6 Recognition rather than recall
findings.title: Hesitation over “someone@example.com”
findings.detail: User hovered for 13.7 s without acting — a sign of uncertainty about what this control does or what will happen.
findings.fix: Clarify the label, add helper text or a preview of the outcome; reduce ambiguity between similar options.

findings.principle: Nielsen #5 & #9 — Error prevention; help users recover
findings.title: JavaScript error (×2)
findings.detail: Uncaught ReferenceError: hljs is not defined
findings.fix: Fix the error; wrap risky operations so failures show recoverable UI rather than breaking silently.

findings.title: Dead click on “HOME”
findings.detail: 1 click produced no visible change (no DOM update, no navigation) within 1 s. The element is interactive, so feedback is missing or delayed.
findings.fix: Provide immediate visual feedback (active state, spinner, toast) for every action.

findings.title: Field friction: “passwd”
findings.detail: Focused 2×, 12 deletions vs 25 keystrokes, 15.4 s total. Users are struggling with the expected format or meaning.
findings.fix: Show the expected format up front (example/mask), validate inline as the user types, and accept flexible input.

findings.title: Form started but not submitted (3 fields touched)
findings.detail: On /e0b26355-1889-40d8-8ef1-e559616befda/oauth2/v2.0/authorize the user interacted with 3 fields but never submitted.
findings.fix: Reduce the number of fields, show progress, save drafts, and make the primary action obvious.

findings.title: 16 text element(s) below 12 px on /aura
findings.detail: Very small text is hard to read, especially on mobile and for older users.
findings.fix: Use ≥ 16 px for body text and ≥ 12 px for captions.

findings.title: Slow LCP 3.9 s on /
findings.detail: Largest Contentful Paint should be ≤ 2.5 s. Users perceive the page as slow to load.
findings.fix: Optimise the hero image/text, reduce render-blocking resources, improve server response.

findings.title: Layout shift CLS 0.131 on /
findings.detail: Content moves while users are reading or about to click — a common cause of mis-clicks.
findings.fix: Reserve space for images, ads and async content; avoid inserting content above existing content.
